body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> TomTom introduced 'Nike+ SportWatch GPS' at The Digital Experience, America's largest and best attended consumer electronics media event, which was held annually on the eve of the International Consumer Electronics Show.
